recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片在兩條骨小樑之間，箭頭圍出一塊顏色較淡、細胞較鬆散的粉紅區域，由成片的上皮樣組織球構成，和周圍深色的造血細胞明顯不同，這就是骨髓肉芽腫。
features: Well-circumscribed pale eosinophilic nodule between bony trabeculae (arrows)
Nodule composed of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm, admixed lymphocytes
Contrasts with the surrounding darker, cellular hematopoietic marrow and fat spaces
No obvious central necrosis at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at low power shows a pale, relatively well-circumscribed nodule (arrows) located between bony trabeculae, composed of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and admixed lymphocytes. The surrounding marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with interspersed fat. Central necrosis is not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with an epithelioid granuloma in the bone marrow; special stains for mycobacteria and fungi plus clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoid aggregates are dark-staining collections of small lymphocytes without pale epithelioid cytoplasm.
Gelatinous transformation shows acellular pale extracellular material with fat atrophy rather than a cellular nodule of histiocytes.
Mast cell lesions are often paratrabecular with spindle cells, eosinophils and fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD117/CD25-positive.
